text: おとうとの　グリーンなら　おじいちゃんの　けんきゅうじょよ

structure.jp: おとうとの　グリーンなら
structure.en: if it's my little brother Green (you want)

structure.jp: おじいちゃんの　けんきゅうじょよ

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a name picks it up as the topic: 'if that's who you mean'. グリーンなら = 'if it's Green you're after'.

patterns.name: 〜の (apposition)
patterns.span: おとうとの　グリーン
patterns.explanation: Here の does not mean 'of'; it says both words are the same person. おとうとの　グリーン = 'my little brother, Green'.
